### Privacy

Laufbursche Edition is offline-first: it collects nothing and sends no telemetry to the authors or to Trittbrett. It talks only to your scooter over Bluetooth and - only on your explicit action - to the OpenStreetMap / BRouter servers for offline map downloads, to the SRT server you configure or to GitHub to check for and download an app update. There is no account and no login. Full details: [PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/Laufbursche42/tb-lb-edition/blob/main/PRIVACY.md).
